structuredContent.body:
Remove only the two provenance files introduced by aea707d6e8ef2c765531f7c7bcee0441fa5f076e so the reviewed change can be reapplied through the required pull-request and status-check path. The ordinary direct push was unexpectedly accepted using the credential’s server-side bypass privilege; this repair preserves history and changes no protection settings.

Validation: the resulting source tree exactly matches 359fee24aeca4d9eabed4b425d4cfa2520b2adda; the full commit/PR subject passed the pinned commitlint CLI. Publication remains held until the checked reapplication merges.
